notes: Mixed classification: Simulation is dominant and owns shape and preset. Action contributes the bot emitter, and Obby contributes the course the prompt asks to be placed somewhere reachable.
P6 comes from the obby course only. The rest of the map is P0, so the obby section needs generating by construction while the bases do not.
Shape is plot-isolated rather than the Tycoon presets shared plot: each player claims their own movie base.
Theme cannot be expressed: every base is a different film franchise and the handoff has one theme field. The franchises named are also licensed IP, which the pipeline should know before drawing them.
Most of the prompt is monetisation - titles at fixed Robux prices, gamepasses, aura, bounty - and none of it can enter the handoff.
